cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Cílem předmětu je přiblížit základy stavební fyziky z pohledu transportu tepla a vlhkosti v budovách. V rámci kurzu jsou zmíněny i základy návrhu nízkoenergetických budov a vyžití obnovitelných zdrojů energie.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The primary objective of course is focused on fundamental aspects of building physics covering heat and moisture transfer in buildings point of view. This course briefly provides fundamental design concepts of nZEB (Nearly Zero Energy Building) architecture and renewable energy sources.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Introduction to the building physics (allowance 2/0)2.Building components (allowance 12/0) a.heat transport mechanisms, temperature distribution in building components, one and multi-dimensional heat flow, thermal bridgesb.moisture in building components and its transport mechanisms, moisture distribution, surface and interstitial condensationc.assessment of building components, calculation tools3.Building and indoor environment (allowance 6/0) a.indoor environmentb.whole building heat and mass transferc.building simulation and calculation tools4.nearly Zero Energy Buildings and renewable energy sources (allowance 4/0) a.concept of nZEBb.renewable energy sources and its implementation in buildings
